component.name: AppGlider
component.summary: Install, update and launch AppImages from GitHub

description.p: AppGlider installs, updates and launches AppImage apps from GitHub, from one window. Add any public GitHub repository that publishes an AppImage, and AppGlider downloads it, checks it against the checksum the project published, adds it to your application menu and tells you when a new version is out.

ul.li: Checks every download against its published SHA-256 before installing
Keeps the previous version so you can roll back if an update misbehaves
Stable releases by default, with previews and release notes per app
Hold an app at its current version
Update all, a tray icon with an update badge and optional notifications
Your own app order and pinned favourites
Share lists of apps as plain-text catalogs

description.p: AppGlider only manages the apps it installed itself; AppImages you already have are left alone.
